abstention_condition: root discoverable via an evidence tier but not yet authored → route to inheritance/authoring, never hedge
defeaters: the row asserts a spaced-radical root (top-level root / morphline 'root ح ق ق' / segment sarf_note)
the row is a genuine function word carrying a typed rootless rationale (see N-ROOT-02)

projector.condition: content-segment row where root is not asserted AND a hedge phrase is present
projector.projection: flag norm-nonconformant (N-ROOT-01); route to entry-root inheritance / authoring

relationships.note: The hedge ban is the positive-obligation partner to the two-tier certification bar.

scope: N-ROOT-01 (MUST): a row carrying a content segment (qg-verb-stem / qg-noun-stem / qg-noun / qg-adjective / qg-verb / qg-proper-noun / generic qg-segment) MUST NOT decline its root with hedge prose ('no public root asserted', 'function only no root', 'no unsupported root added'). This catches the multi-segment hedge (فَحَقَّ = FA+TOK) and the clean stem (خَلَقَ) that C2's single-segment gate skips.

abstention_condition: rootless status genuinely uncertain → 'pending', never silent or hedge
defeaters: the row asserts a root (N-ROOT-02 is n/a)
the typed field carries one of the four closed-vocabulary values

projector.condition: row asserts no root and carries no recognized typed-rationale field value
guards: hedge prose is not a typed value
projector.projection: flag nonconformant; require a closed-vocabulary typed rationale (NEW field)

relationships.note: The typed-rationale field is the SHOULD complement to the N-ROOT-01 hedge ban.

scope: N-ROOT-02 (SHOULD): a genuinely rootless row MUST carry an EXPLICIT TYPED rationale from a closed vocabulary — function-word / proper-name / jamid-contested / pending — in a dedicated field (no_root_reason / rootless_rationale). Never silent, never hedge prose, never a free-text morphline standing in for the typed value.

defeaters: the field is clean English learner content with no meta-marker and no `\b[A-Z]{1,6}:\S` label leak

projector.condition: rendered field matches the meta-marker blocklist OR regex \b[A-Z]{1,6}:\S in learner_explanation
projector.projection: flag N-LANG-01 nonconformant; rewrite to clean English learner content

relationships.note: Generalizes the C4 rendered-field honesty check to the full meta-language + label-leak blocklist.

scope: N-LANG-01 (MUST): no rendered field (learner_explanation / gloss / sarf_note / nahw_note / morphline) may carry internal validator/process meta-language ('no unsupported public source label', 'visible piece accounted', 'preserved where relevant', 'no public root asserted') — a SUPERSET of C4's three phrases — nor leaked uppercase segment-label notation (FA:فَ, TOK:حَقَّ, ADJ:حَقِيقٌ) inside learner text.

defeaters: the field is substantive English with only short quoted Arabic forms (below the thresholds)

projector.condition: arabic_words>=6 OR (arabic_words>=4 and arabic_ratio>=0.6) OR (latin_words<3 and arabic_words>=3)
projector.projection: flag N-LANG-02 nonconformant; rewrite the learner field in English

relationships.note: No released class inspects learner-text language balance.

scope: N-LANG-02 (MUST): learner-facing fields MUST be English; learner_explanation MUST NOT be an Arabic-prose dump. Flag when arabic_words>=6, OR (arabic_words>=4 AND arabic_ratio>=0.6), OR (latin_words<3 AND arabic_words>=3). Short quoted Arabic forms inside an English sentence stay clean.

defeaters: every segment carries a non-empty gloss_contribution

projector.condition: any segment has a blank/empty gloss_contribution
projector.projection: flag N-PED-01 nonconformant; author the missing per-segment gloss

relationships.note: Every segment must contribute a learner gloss.

scope: N-PED-01 (MUST): every segment MUST carry a non-empty gloss_contribution — every piece teaches. The released schema permits an empty gloss today; a blank gloss_contribution on any segment is nonconforming.

abstention_condition: same-surface conflict is a genuine homograph → record the homograph rationale, do not silently hedge
defeaters: no sibling in the same-surface group asserts a root (nothing to cohere with)
the divergence carries a recorded homograph rationale (a genuine two-reading surface)

projector.condition: in a folded-bare-surface group with >=1 rooted content row, this content row hedges/omits the root
projector.projection: flag N-CONS-01 nonconformant; inherit the sibling's root or record a homograph rationale

relationships.note: Same-surface rows must have compatible analyses or a recorded homograph rationale.

scope: N-CONS-01 (MUST): within a diacritic-folded bare-surface group where >=1 content row asserts a root, any content row that hedges/omits the root is nonconforming. The producer had ح ق ق for حَقَّتْ (39:71:30) yet served فَحَقَّ (38:14:6) rootless 25 rows away.

abstention_condition: surface matches no attested entry form → authoring-first; never inherit from pattern shape
defeaters: the surface matches no entry headword/form → authoring-first (no fabricated inheritance)
the match is within-root ambiguous / homograph / cross-source-conflict → held for 2-vote

projector.condition: rootless content row; normalized surface == an entry headword/usage.form (attested source)
projector.projection: project the entry root as certification_state=candidate (tier-0 inheritance)

relationships.note: The affirmative arm: an attested entry headword/form IS the ownership arm the HOLD rule waits for.

scope: N-CONS-02 / lexeme join: a rootless content row whose (dagger-alef-normalized) surface matches a Qamus entry's headword or usage[].forms inherits that entry's root as a CANDIDATE (tier-0). 16:3:1 خَلَقَ IS the headword of entry c8190204; 7:54:23 مُسَخَّرَٰتٍ matches v198 usage.forms. Pattern alone never certifies — attested source only — and the projection stays certification_state=candidate until the 2-vote.

abstention_condition: carrier entry_id present but surface-is-a-form unverified → context-only, do not assert its root
defeaters: the carried surface IS an attested form of the carrier entry → tier-A self-join is usable

projector.condition: a carrier entry_id is present but the row surface is NOT a form of that entry
guards: bare id is never a root
projector.projection: PREVENT a root assertion from the bare id; keep it example-context only

relationships.note: The bare-entry_id-is-context-only correction that keeps tier-A honest.

scope: Lexeme-join correction: a row's carrier entry_id is an EXAMPLE-CONTEXT link, NOT a root assertion — فَوْقَكُمُ carries the أخذ entry's id. The carrier certifies a root ONLY when the surface is actually a form of that entry (tier-A self-join); a bare entry_id NEVER asserts a root.

abstention_condition: row/entry roots disagree → 2-vote/review; never majority-vote or pick one automatically
defeaters: row root and entry root are equal after normalization → confirm (root_confirms)

projector.condition: row asserts root_a and the matched entry attests root_b and root_a != root_b

relationships.note: Extends the never-majority-vote conflict veto from two SOURCES to row-vs-entry.

scope: Lexeme-join conflict: when a row's asserted root DISAGREES with the root of the entry that attests the same surface (464 rows / 804 root_conflict edges in the join), route to 2-vote/review and NEVER auto-resolve. An agreeing row/entry pair is confirmed (root_confirms).

defeaters: no مادة idiom and no root field → genuinely rootless

projector.condition: a root appears in the مادة/مادّة (radicals) idiom (not the `root <radicals>` form)
guards: مادة-idiom parse added to the root recognizer
projector.projection: recognize the root as ASSERTED; do not classify the row rootless

relationships.note: Extends the root recognizer to the مادة lexicographic idiom.

scope: ANDON gap G4: a root carried in the Arabic lexicographic idiom مادة (كلم) / مادّة is an ASSERTED root. The released `_ROOT_ARABIC_RE` recognized only the pattern `root <radicals>` and read a row carrying its root in مادة-prose as rootless (39:71:31 كَلِمَةُ carries 'مادة (كلم)').

abstention_condition: trailing ت radical-vs-suffix genuinely uncertain → 2-vote, never a blind split
defeaters: the plural suffix is already its own segment (ينَ split, as in الكافرين) → conformant
the trailing ـات ت is a root radical → the guard routes to 2-vote, no split

projector.condition: single-blob token ending in a sound plural ـات/ـين (+tanwīn), suffix not segmented
projector.projection: flag a suffix-swallow; project STEM + PL-F/PL split (closes the O-2 gap)

relationships.note: Adds the sound-plural suffix vocabulary C5 lacked, with the radical-ت homograph guard.

scope: ANDON gap G6 / O-2: C5's enclitic vocabulary is PRONOUN-only, so a sound feminine/masculine plural ـات / ـين (+ tanwīn) fused into a single blob (7:54:23 مُسَخَّرَٰتٍ) is a suffix-swallow that escapes C5. Detect it and split STEM + PL-F/PL, INDEPENDENT of the root check. GUARD: a trailing ت that is a ROOT RADICAL routes to 2-vote, not a split (sarf-root-radical-not-clitic).

abstention_condition: مُ-pattern present but the form is unattested → hold, do not name a fabricated wazn
defeaters: the entry attests the derived form → name the pattern in the morphline (taught)
the مُ- token is not a derivational pattern at all → n/a

projector.condition: token carries a مُ- derivational pattern AND the entry attests the derived form
projector.projection: NAME the pattern (wazn) in the morphline as taught; keep the مُ stem-internal (no coloured peel)

relationships.note: Colour partner: like the Form V/VI ت, the مُ- augment is stem-internal but must be NAMED when attested.

scope: C5 / W1-A pedagogy: the مُ- derivational pattern (مُفَعَّل / تَفَعَّل) is STEM-INTERNAL for colour — never peeled as a separate coloured segment (per the DR-1 wazn-augment boundary) — BUT when the entry attests the form the pattern MUST be NAMED in the morphline (مُسَخَّر → 'Form II passive participle, wazn mufaʿʿal'). If unattested it is held, never fabricated.

defeaters: every template slot's fact is asserted by the morphline → the full template may render

projector.condition: the learner template has any slot whose fact the morphline does not assert
guards: no morphology work required for the honesty fix
projector.projection: render the honest-generic variant (deterministic; no morphology authoring needed)

relationships.note: Generalizes the single completeness sentence into a per-slot honest-template rule.

scope: C4 + measured-effect telemetry: the learner sentence renders from a TEMPLATE whose slots emit ONLY facts the morphline actually asserts; if any slot fact is abstained the honest-generic variant renders. Generalizes the completeness-claim rule; the 100%-agreement telemetry (ONH-B5 et al.) confirms the honest form is the measured target.

abstention_condition: only a local index confirms the address → cannot prevalidate; do not emit on circular evidence
defeaters: an external authority (corpus/wbw oracle) confirms the address → emit

projector.condition: an address is confirmed only by a local index and not by an external authority
projector.projection: cannot prevalidate (circular); block the emit until an external authority confirms

relationships.note: Adds the anti-circularity rule: the cross-check authority must be EXTERNAL, not a local index.

scope: C5 / W1-A: a loc-range / address claim MUST be prevalidated against an EXTERNAL authority (corpus/wbw oracle) — a local index validating itself is CIRCULAR. The 17:1:22 catch proved a local index confirmed an address the external authority rejected. Local-only confirmation cannot prevalidate.

defeaters: the surface has no dagger-alef → the plain match key already applies

projector.condition: the surface contains U+0670 (dagger-alef); fold it to plain alif before matching
projector.projection: match against the entry/wbw form after normalization (recovers ذٰلك / مُسَخَّرَٰت)

relationships.note: The match key must fold the dagger-alef the demonstrative/derived forms carry.

scope: W13: the demonstrative ذٰلِك / كَذٰلِك (and forms like مُسَخَّرَٰت) carries a superscript dagger-alef (U+0670) that the match engine missed TWICE. Normalize dagger-alef → plain alif before the wbw / entry-form match; a form that already matches without a dagger-alef is untouched.

defeaters: the note opens with a substantive English clause before any Arabic term

projector.condition: a sarf_note/nahw_note opens with sustained Arabic prose rather than English
projector.projection: flag N-LANG-03 nonconformant; lead the note with English, Arabic terms may follow

relationships.note: Grammatical notes may cite Arabic terms but must lead in English.

scope: N-LANG-03 (SHOULD): a sarf_note / nahw_note MAY cite Arabic grammatical terms but MUST lead with English; a note that opens as an Arabic-prose dump is nonconforming.

defeaters: the nahw_note is an English iʿrāb (with at most short quoted Arabic terms)

projector.condition: the nahw_note equals the raw-analyzer Arabic iʿrāb string verbatim (sustained Arabic prose)
projector.projection: flag N-LANG nonconformant; author an English iʿrāb note

relationships.note: The raw analyzer iʿrāb is analysis input, not learner-rendered copy.

scope: N-LANG-01/02 for the iʿrāb note: the nahw_note MUST NOT be the raw upstream-analyzer Arabic iʿrāb string pasted VERBATIM into the learner field (39:71:31 كَلِمَةُ carried 'فاعل مرفوع وعلامة رفعه الضمة وهو مضاف'); render an English iʿrāb ('subject, nominative; first term of an iḍāfa').

abstention_condition: mood genuinely unknowable at the address → named ambiguity, never the 'as context requires' hedge
defeaters: mood is knowable and the note commits it (no hedge)
mood is genuinely qirāʾāt-split/unknowable → a named ambiguity is legal, not a hedge

projector.condition: mood is knowable at the address AND the note hedges 'as (the) context requires'
projector.projection: flag N-PED-02 nonconformant; commit the mood in the note

relationships.note: The rendered-note obligation partner to the mood-from-governor rule.

scope: N-PED-02 for the mood note: when mood is knowable at the exact address the nahw_note MUST commit it and MUST NOT hedge 'as (the) context requires'; when genuinely unknowable it states a named ambiguity.
